title: App-Based Optimization of Long-Term CPAP Adherence and Quality of Life
official: An App-Based, Precision Medicine Approach to Optimize Long-Term CPAP Adherence and Quality of Life
summary: The purpose of this study is to optimize the time of CPAP usage to at least 6 hours a night for 6 nights per week for people who have OSA with the help of a smartphone application called SmartWell24. This application aims to target CPAP adherence.
